# Scout assignment example

Objective: Determine how `[specific behavior]` currently works.

Scope: Read only `[repository path, files, or subsystem]`. Do not edit, delegate, access external systems, or broaden into implementation design.

Acceptance criteria: Identify the actual control/data path, relevant tests, evidence for each material claim, and unresolved questions.

Validation: Run only safe read-only commands relevant to the assigned path.

Deliverable: Direct answer; exact paths and symbols; relevant tests; risks; and the smallest implementation boundary if requested.

Stop conditions: Return when the bounded question is answered. If two targeted approaches fail, return the best evidence and blocker.
